import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     c=df['model_year'], cmap='viridis', 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/3, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(Size=Weight, Color=Year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Year')

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts()
ax2.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=colors[:len(brand_counts)])
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Count by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor Type distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%',
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel", len(sensor_counts)), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Weight vs Price
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax4.scatter(row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd'], 
               s=150, alpha=0.7, label=row['brand'], color=colors[i])
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Price by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(fontsize=8, loc='best')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Timeline of releases
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax5.scatter(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'], 
               s=row['megapixels']*5, alpha=0.6, color=colors[i])
    ax5.text(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'], row['brand'], 
            fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Price Timeline\n(Size=Megapixels)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Max ISO comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df_sorted = df.sort_values('max_iso')
bars = ax6.barh(range(len(df_sorted)), df_sorted['max_iso'], color=colors)
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(df_sorted)))
ax6.set_yticklabels([f"{row['brand']}\n({row['model_year']})" 
                      for _, row in df_sorted.iterrows()], fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Body Type distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax7.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(body_counts)))
ax7.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. 4K Video capability
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
ax8.pie(video_4k.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.0f%%',
        colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], startangle=90)
ax8.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Summary statistics table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_data = [
    ['Avg Price:', f"${df['price_usd'].mean():.2f}"],
    ['Avg Megapixels:', f"{df['megapixels'].mean():.1f}"],
    ['Avg Weight:', f"{df['weight_grams'].mean():.0f}g"],
    ['Max ISO Range:', f"{df['max_iso'].min()}-{df['max_iso'].max()}"],
    ['Year Range:', f"{df['model_year'].min()}-{df['model_year'].max()}"]
]
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_data, cellLoc='left',
                  colWidths=[0.5, 0.5], loc='center',
                  cellColours=[['#f0f0f0', '#ffffff']]*5)
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
